name: my:Optima Secure follow-up dialogues v2
description: Conversations for evaluating conversation memory, written and frozen before any run with them. Each later turn's complete form is the test-set question named in 'item' (all on the test split and answered correctly in the published baseline), so its answer key scores the answer. follow_up / after_refusal: the follow-up leaves out its subject (checked when loaded); subject: names of what it refers to, one of which the rewrite must contain. self_contained: a follow-up that names its subject. topic_switch: a new question asked exactly as in the test set. must_mention: further groups the rewrite must contain; must_not_mention: earlier-topic terms it must not pull in.
